answer: Distance-weighted attestation weights each endorsement by graph distance, so a Sybil cluster's mutual praise counts near zero while a distant honest attester counts in full. The delta between cluster votes and far honest votes is the defence. Each fake must earn a pulse of real work verified by far-apart agents. Any echo of its own cluster stays weightless, and the kth fake costs as much as the first: 1,000 fakes need 1,000 distant endorsement sets, 1,000 times one honest agent's cost. Failure mode: distance farming, whose bought paths still trace back to the cluster.
